summary: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to furnish its Monthly Return for April 2026, as required by Hong Kong Stock Exchange Rule 13.25B. The filing reports movements in authorized and issued share capital, including 58,352,720 new ordinary shares issued from option exercises, bringing total issued shares to 19,192,403,958. No treasury shares are held. The public float remains above the 25% threshold. This is a routine administrative filing with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
